Class EX (deliberate deviation, HiCExplorer 4 fix 2, project owner 2026-11-06): hicInterIntraTAD now processes an h5 matrix. 3.7.6 divided by zero for the last TAD of every chromosome (its left block had no columns) and exited 1 before writing anything; the corrected geometry gives the last TAD a left block, identical bin ranges for cool and h5, and the run writes its table. test_hicInterIntraTAD.py::test_h5_input_matches_cool_input pins that the rows equal those of the cool run.
